overall: The Planning Board violated the Open Meeting Law by taking two to four months to approve minutes, but its prompt approval of the outstanding minutes was appropriate remedial action, so the AG closed the complaint by informal action with no further order.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Planning Board failed to timely approve minutes of four open session meetings held March 3 through May 11, 2015.
